findings.evidence: `Complexification.lean:449` defines `conjEquiv` on all sections with `conjEquiv_apply` (`:493`) and `conjEquiv_symm` (`:496`). The PR's `CompactlySupported.tsupport_conjEquiv` and `SupportedIn.tsupport_conjEquiv` are the same proof (`not_congr (map_eq_zero_iff (tmulConj (V x)) …)`), and the same holds for the two `tsupport_smulIEquiv` proofs and the two `conv_rhs … I_smul_one_tmul_add_I_tmul` proofs.
findings.fix: Prove once at section level that `(ContMDiffSection.conjEquiv I F n V σ).tsupport = σ.tsupport` and `(Complex.I • σ).tsupport = σ.tsupport`. Then obtain both carriers' equivalences by restricting the existing all-section maps to the submodule (e.g. `LinearEquiv.ofSubmodules` on `restrictScalars ℝ`), and derive the apply/support/involution laws from the section-level ones.
findings.issue: `CompactlySupported.conjEquiv`/`smulIEquiv` and `SupportedIn.conjEquiv`/`smulIEquiv` are each rebuilt through pair coordinates. Their `_apply`, `tsupport_*`, `_conjEquiv`/`_smulIEquiv` square and `_symm_apply` laws are proved four times with near-identical proofs, although both carriers are defined only by a `tsupport` condition and the all-section `ContMDiffSection.conjEquiv` and the native ℂ-scalar `I • σ` already exist.

findings.evidence: In `Support.lean:184`, `def ofSupportedIn (K : Compacts M)` uses `K.isCompact` only to land in `compactlySupported`, while `supportedIn (K : Set M)` at `:133` is defined for every set.
findings.fix: Define the pullback along `(supportedIn … K).subtype`, composed with a `Module.complexToReal`-compatible forgetful map, for `K : Set M`. Keep `Compacts` only in the `ofSupportedIn` compatibility lemma and the `frameTopology` CLE.
findings.issue: `SupportedIn.realPointsConj`, `mem_realPointsConj` and `realPointsConjEquiv` take `K : Compacts M` only because they factor through `ofSupportedIn`. The neighbouring `SupportedIn.complexificationEquivProd`, `conjEquiv` and `smulIEquiv` accept any `K : Set M`, and the fixed-point comparison never uses compactness.

summary: The earlier ℕ∞ω findings are resolved. Conjugation and the quarter-turn are rebuilt and their laws re-proved separately on each carrier instead of once at section level, and the stage fixed submodule needlessly requires `Compacts`.
